headline: Libas Consumer Products submits AGM proceedings and voting results
hook: Routine AGM and voting results filed
summary: Libas Consumer Products Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company also submitted the scrutinizer's report along with the official voting results. For retail shareholders, this is standard compliance reporting following an annual shareholder meeting. Such routine filings have no direct impact on the company's financial performance or stock price.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for your portfolio.
